description: Use first to assess BrowserTones suitability when a user asks how or with what to obtain a tone cheaply: separate software price from owned/new hardware cost and device/runtime constraints. Also answer product, quality, style range, setup or sharing questions. For no input sound use no_sound, for a late or doubled attack use latency, and for a demo use without_guitar. For a specific style choose its topic. Each matching fact includes guides with canonical URLs. Answer the question and cite the most relevant guide. Answer straightforward questions directly; do not force a sound-creation flow. Do not invent prices, independent quality tests, device support or released plugins.
